overview.subtitle: Your business at a glance · {{ date }}
overview.allGood: Every customer is in good standing.
overview.collectedHint: Paid invoices per month, last 12 months.
overview.trialsEnding: {{ n }} trials end in the next 14 days.

reports.title: Reports
reports.revenueHint: MRR, cash collected and new customers per month (12 months).
reports.customersHint: Every customer with plan, cycle, status and start date.
reports.invoicesHint: All invoices with dates, amounts and status.

customers.title: Customers
customers.subtitle: Every company on Humano: their plan, what they bring in and how they're doing.

customer.termsAccepted: Accepted terms v{{ version }} on {{ date }}
customer.suspendedBody: Nobody at this company can sign in or use Humano until you reactivate it. Their data is kept.
customer.subscriptionHint: What they're on and when it renews.
customer.workspaceHint: Their dedicated database and organisation set-up.
customer.noPool: No open database connections right now.
customer.invoicesHint: Everything billed to this customer, newest first.
customer.dangerBody: Deletes this customer's database and every record in it, and deactivates the account. This cannot be undone.
customer.suspendBody: Everyone at this company is signed out and locked out until you reactivate the workspace. Billing and data are kept.
customer.reactivateBody: People at this company can sign in and use Humano again straight away.
customer.deprovisionBody: Their database and all HR and payroll records are deleted permanently. Export anything you need first.
customer.cycleHint: Yearly is billed upfront at 15% off.
customer.changePlanHint: The new price applies from the next renewal.
customer.cancelBody: At period end, they keep access until the current period ends. Immediately ends it now.

done.cancelledAtEnd: Subscription will end at the end of the period.

customer.storageHint: What the workspace stores, its limit, and extra storage bought on top of the plan.
customer.storageNotOnPlan: Extra storage can be added on these plans: {{ types }}. Change the plan first.
customer.storageDialogHint: Packs of {{ size }} GB, billed monthly on top of the subscription. Set a price for a negotiated deal; it applies to all their packs. 0 packs removes it.
customer.storageSummary: {{ gb }} GB extra · {{ monthly }} a month

invoices.downloadFailed: The invoice PDF could not be downloaded. Try again.

confirmBody.pay: Use this for payments received outside the card processor (bank transfer, cheque).
confirmBody.overdue: The customer is flagged as late and dunning starts.
confirmBody.void: The invoice is cancelled and no longer owed. This cannot be undone.

billing.title: Billing
billing.subtitle: Invoices, plans and coupons across every customer.

plans.hint: Prices are per month; yearly plans are billed at 12 months minus 15%.
plans.name: Name
plans.priceHint: Existing customers move to the new price at their next renewal.
plans.retired: Plan retired — existing customers keep it.
plans.compareHint: What each plan includes — this is what explains the price difference between them.
plans.whatsIncludedHint: Tick what this plan offers. Leave a limit empty for unlimited; add a short note where useful (e.g. "Email & chat").
plans.descriptionHint: One line under the plan name on the public pricing page.

coupons.hint: Discount codes customers can apply when they subscribe.
coupons.deleteBody: The code stops working. Invoices that already used it are unaffected.
coupons.cycleHint: E.g. a founding offer on yearly billing only.
coupons.plansHint: Leave all unticked for every plan.

team.title: Team
team.subtitle: The people who run Humano.
team.ownerCan: Everything: customers (suspend, reactivate, deprovision), billing changes (plans, coupons, invoices, subscriptions), reports and the team.
team.adminCan: Customers (view, provision, suspend and reactivate), billing and reports — read-only for billing and no access to the team.
team.emailHint: They get an email to set their password.
team.removeBody: They lose access to the console straight away.

features.empty: No features yet — add what your plans include to explain their prices.
features.name: Name
features.categoryHint: Groups rows in the comparison, e.g. {{ list }}.
features.unitHint: What the limit counts, shown after the number (e.g. 25 employees).
features.deleteBody: It disappears from every plan and from the comparison.

demos.title: Demos
demos.subtitle: Demo requests from the website, and the demo workspaces you run for prospects.
demos.extendBody: Adds time from today, or from the current expiry if that is later. An expired demo reopens.
demos.convertBody: The workspace and everything in it stays — including the sample data. It leaves Demos, appears under Customers and gets a subscription on the plan you pick.
demos.created: Demo created — it is being set up
demos.emptyHint: Set one up from a request, or with New demo.

confirm.expireBody: The workspace locks right away. Its data stays; extend it to reopen.
confirm.deleteBody: The workspace and its database are removed for good. This cannot be undone.
confirm.resetBody: Every login of this demo gets a new shared password; the current one stops working.

creds.title: Demo sign-in details
creds.body: Share these with the prospect. The password is shown only now — generate a new one from the list if it gets lost.

form.subdomainHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens; at least 3 characters.
form.planHint: The demo shows this plan's features. Defaults to the featured plan.
form.sampleDataHint: About 50 employees with org chart, leave, timesheets, expenses, reviews and payroll history.
form.backgroundBody: Creating the workspace and its sample company takes a few minutes. You get the sign-in details now; the list shows when it is ready.

request.emptyHint: Requests from the website's “Book a demo” form show up here.

addons.mrrHint: Extra storage on running subscriptions, billed monthly
addons.hint: Extra storage customers bought on top of their plan. Monthly plans carry it on their renewal invoice; yearly plans get a monthly add-on invoice.
addons.ownInvoice: Own monthly invoice · billed until {{ date }}
addons.emptyHint: When customers buy extra storage, or you add it for them from their page, it shows here.

compliance.title: Data protection
compliance.subtitle: The retention period, workspaces due for deletion after their subscription ended, and notices of new sub-processors to customers.
compliance.disabled: Workspace deletion is switched off in this environment's configuration: nothing below will be warned or deleted.
compliance.overdue: {{ n }} deletion warning(s) should have gone out and have not. Check that email is configured; nothing is deleted until the warning is sent.

kpi.warnedHint: At least {{ days }} days' notice before deletion
kpi.noticesHint: Sent at least {{ days }} days ahead

deletions.title: Scheduled deletions
deletions.hint: A workspace is deleted {{ days }} days after its subscription ended, and only once its admin has been warned and {{ warning }} full days have passed since. Reactivating it stops this.
deletions.emptyHint: Workspaces whose trial lapsed or that were cancelled show here until they are deleted or reactivated.

notices.title: Sub-processor notices
notices.hint: Before a new sub-processor starts processing customer data, every customer must be told at least {{ days }} days ahead. Add it to the sub-processor list in the DPA too.
notices.name: Sub-processor
notices.emptyHint: Notices you send to customers about new sub-processors are listed here as the record.

notice.title: Notice of a new sub-processor
notice.body: This emails the contact of every customer workspace whose data we hold. The start date must be at least {{ days }} days away; customers can object until then.
notice.purposeHint: What it does for humano, e.g. "Transactional email delivery".
notice.locationHint: Where data is processed, and the transfer safeguard if outside the EEA.
notice.dateHint: At least {{ days }} days from today.
notice.reach: It will go to {{ n }} workspace(s).
notice.annex: Remember to update the sub-processor list (Annex 3 of the DPA) before the start date.
notice.missing: {{ n }} workspace(s) have no contact address and did not get it.
notice.failed: {{ n }} could not be sent (see the server log); send them the notice by hand.

retention.title: Retention period
retention.hint: How long a workspace is kept after its subscription ends, and when its admin is warned. The Terms, Privacy Policy, DPA, website and emails quote these figures.
retention.upcoming: From {{ date }}: {{ days }} days, warned {{ warning }} days before.
retention.upcomingHint: It applies only to subscriptions that end from that day. The Terms already announce it; tell your customers by email too.
retention.changeBody: This is part of your Terms of Service. A workspace is never deleted before the date its warning email gave.
retention.daysHint: From the day the subscription or trial ends.
retention.warningHint: The workspace is never deleted sooner than this after the warning was sent.
retention.longerHint: Longer, or the same: applies at once, to every workspace — including those already waiting to be deleted.
retention.shorterTitle: Shorter: a change to your Terms
retention.shorterBody: It needs at least {{ days }} days' notice, and applies only to subscriptions that end on or after its start date; workspaces whose subscription ended before keep the current period. Tell your customers by email.
retention.effectiveHint: At least {{ days }} days from today.
retention.warningRange: Between 1 and {{ max }} days, and less than the retention period.
retention.dateTooSoon: Choose a date at least {{ days }} days from today.
